text:
Maya: Quick sync — finalizing launch criteria for Console Observability. I put together a compact acceptance checklist from customer asks; want engineering + SRE signoff before we lock the GA scope.
Ravi (Eng Lead): Share the checklist pls. we should call out hard vs nice-to-have.
Maya: Yep — short list: 1) Ops dashboards (top-10 views) for latency/cost/error, 2) Tracing hooks on hot paths with adjustable sample rate, 3) Per-route cost breakdown (tokens + cache hits), 4) Error analytics: aggregated + per-tenant rollup + root-cause links. Must-haves for GA: dashboards + basic cost breakdown + error aggregation. Tracing hooks can be soft-must for critical customers.
Jules (SRE): For launch we need SLOs + alert thresholds. What are the expected error rates to trigger alerts?
Maya: Proposal: default alert = 3x baseline error rate OR >5% errors for 5m on any customer-facing route. We can tune with customers.
Elena (Observability): Concretely: tracing hooks will be an opt-in flag per model/route. Sampling defaults: 0.1% global, 5% for hot endpoints. Customers can override. Example config: 
```
tracing: { sample_rate: 0.001, hotspots: [{route: "/v1/generate", sample_rate: 0.05}] }
```
Ben (CS): Customers asked specifically for per-tenant cost views and a CSV export for billing ops. They also want breakdown by model version.
Ravi (Eng Lead): Per-tenant cost needs dataset-level aggregation — feasible but incremental. We can ship per-route + model-version in UI first, then per-tenant CSV in sprint+1.
Jules (SRE): Can we avoid high-cardinality pitfalls for error analytics? Per-tenant rollups should be rate-limited and only stored at 1m granularity by default.
Elena (Observability): Agreed. We'll store raw spans for short TTL (48h) and long-term aggregates (1m) for 90 days. That satisfies compliance and keeps costs down.
Maya: Acceptance criteria draft for GA: 
- Dashboards: Top-10 templates deployed, user can filter by tenant/model/version.
- Cost: UI surface showing per-route token spend + cache hit %, downloadable CSV (per-route, per-model).
- Errors: Aggregated error rate panels, top-5 error reasons, tenant rollup. Alerts tied to SLO thresholds.
- Tracing: Hooks instrumented on hot paths, sampling controls exposed in console, docs + rollout plan.
Ravi (Eng Lead): Implementation plan: pair chunking — dashboard templates + backend aggregates (2 sprints), cost UI + CSV (1 sprint), tracing basic hooks + sample controls (2 sprints), alerts + SLO infra (1 sprint). Need to prioritize if we want GA in 6 weeks.
Maya: If we compress: drop CSV from GA and ship per-route/model CSV in sprint2. Keep tracing soft-must: basic hooks in GA, advanced sampling controls in sprint2. Thoughts?
Jules (SRE): I can sign off if CSV is postponed and we have default SLOs + Pager duty playbook. Also need a rollback plan for tracing (disable flag per region).
Elena (Observability): We'll add a kill-switch for tracing and a per-customer toggle. Also add telemetry to confirm we don't exceed trace storage budget.
Ben (CS): OK — customers want the per-tenant CSV soon after GA. I'll communicate the plan and get buy-in.
Ravi (Eng Lead): Sounds good. Final asks for eng: list of API changes for cost/time aggregation and a small schema for tenant rollups. I'll drop a PR with the telemetry schema by EOD.
Maya: Great — action items: 
- Ravi: PR for telemetry schema + resource estimate (EOD)
- Elena: tracing kill-switch + sampling defaults doc (tomorrow)
- Jules: SLO thresholds + PD runbook draft (tomorrow)
- Ben: customer comms summary (by EOD)
deploy-bot: Deployment queued: obs-dashboard-v1 -> staging (sha: abc123).
Ravi (Eng Lead): :thumbsup: pulling in folks on the sprint planning meeting. If we hit blockers we'll call a quick sync.
Maya: Thanks everyone — will update the roadmap doc after the PR.
